label: L-04
title: nonReentrant is not the first modifier in function declaration lists across multiple entry points — modifiers before nonReentrant can execute with reentrancy mutex not yet locked
function: multiple (lines 319, 366 in AYieldStrategy.sol; lines 229, 248, 265, 279 in ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol)
description: Solidity applies modifiers in declaration order. Earlier modifiers (onlyOwner, whenNotPaused, onlyAuthorizedClient) execute before the reentrancy lock is acquired. A malicious modifier body or a modifier with an external call could reenter the contract before the mutex is set.
impact: Low severity in practice: the earlier modifiers do not make external calls. Purely structural risk for future modifier additions.
attackPath: Theoretical: a future modifier added before nonReentrant that makes an external call could reenter the function
Current modifiers are read-only checks with no external calls
